scope: One-second FPS events are not frame times,1%low or0.1%low.
Inclusive sampled stacks include injected handlers and forwarded vanilla work; percentages are not exclusive mod cost or FPS loss.
JFR startup/end can pause JVM; first-session framerate limiter waits must not be attributed to translation.
Safepoint and GC events overlap: do not sum them.
Duration event thresholds may hide shorter waits.
Render-thread cumulative allocation counters cover all mods/game, not WitherSkyRU alone.
Statistical allocation weights are not converted to absolute allocation rates.
